defect: cross-domain counter uses a Gray-looking code that skips with multiple bits changing

mutation.description: The source updates the advertised pointer with a three-bit XOR mask instead of the next binary-to-Gray value.

rationale: The destination samples a purported Gray pointer, but the source can change two bits in one transition, so bitwise synchronizers cannot guarantee a valid pointer code.
author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.note: Every advance toggles two Gray bus bits, so independent synchronization permits incoherent intermediate code.
